As withholding cost τ rises, the minimum-risk school report steps to higher disclosure at exact thresholds.

## Numerical illustrations {#what-to-try}

- **The usual setting.** At τ = .20, the optimum states 45 pairs in sizes 3, 6, 3 (risk .0638).
- **Past the last interior boundary.** At τ = .45, the optimum states 47 pairs in sizes 4, 5, 3 (risk .143).
- **The early boundaries.** At τ = .01, exact steps at .000162 and .000263 reach 27 and 45 pairs below the slider minimum.
- **The upper endpoint.** At τ = .50, the optimum states 47 pairs across 13 archived solves (risk .158).

<details>
<summary>Path properties and scope notes</summary>

With posterior, criterion weight, and the three-grade family held fixed, increasing τ never reduces the total number of stated pairs in an exact optimum, yet moving a whole block boundary can newly withhold pairs stated earlier or state pairs whose individual error exceeds τ. Data lists every changed pair, equal-risk boundary ties within numerical tolerance, and the 13 archived HiGHS runs alongside the browser's exact enumeration. A shared grade leaves relative chronic absence unstated. This twelve-school teaching subset is conditional on a statewide prior fitted to 5,834 eligible schools (prior-estimation uncertainty is not propagated). California's Dashboard colors, school quality, causal effects, and statewide calibration require separate evidence. Related: [Reasons for a withheld comparison](../criteria/why-withheld.qmd) · [The error–disclosure frontier](../grades/frontier.qmd).

</details>

Data: California Department of Education, 2026 California School Dashboard chronic absenteeism data, academic year 2025–26, adapted in postrank 1.1.0 (`pr_case_cde`); <https://www.cde.ca.gov/re/di/cr/index.asp>; not relicensed, provided as is; No CDE endorsement is implied.
